quests.instruction: What do we call the collection that might include a shirt, pants, socks, and shoes all matching? It is not your onesie!
quests.question: Outfit
quests.hint: It is not one item, but a whole matching set.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Outfit is the name for the whole set of clothes you wear together!
quests.funFact: You choose a whole new outfit almost every single morning.

quests.instruction: What do we call the strip where the belt loops are sewn on, around our middle? It is not your cuff!
quests.question: Waistband
quests.hint: It circles around your middle.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Waistband is the snug strip of fabric at the top of pants, around your waist!
quests.funFact: Belt loops are always sewn onto the waistband, not lower down.

quests.instruction: We wear this that is thicker and warmer than a light jacket. It is NOT your hat. What is it?
quests.question: Coat
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is thicker and warmer than a jacket!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Some coats are stuffed with soft, fluffy material to trap warm air.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that makes a happy flip-flap sound as we walk on the sand, not your sneakers. What is it?
quests.question: Flip-Flops
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You can slide these on in one second flat.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Flip-Flops have one simple strap and slide on fast for easy beach days!
quests.funFact: Flip-flops are one of the fastest shoes to slide on and off.

quests.instruction: We wear this to keep our toes warm and cozy. It is NOT your tank top. What is it?
quests.question: Socks
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They go on your feet before your shoes!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Some socks have five little sections, one for each toe.

quests.instruction: We wear this with a soft, rounded top and no floppy edges, but it is not your earmuffs. What is it?
quests.question: Cap
quests.hint: Baseball players often wear these.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Cap has a curved front brim that shades your eyes from the sun!
quests.funFact: Many sports teams have their own special caps with a logo.

quests.instruction: We wear this when we want a warm top with a hood attached, but it is not your sweatshirt. What is it?
quests.question: Hoodie
quests.hint: It usually has a big front pocket.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Hoodie has a warm hood attached that you can pull up over your head!
quests.funFact: Many hoodies have a warm front pocket, perfect for cold hands.

quests.instruction: We wear this that stops above our knees to keep our legs cool. It is NOT your skirt. What is it?
quests.question: Shorts
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They cover your legs, but only a little bit!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: Shorts let air flow around your legs so you feel less sweaty.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the sticky strip that closes instead of laces, buttons, or a zipper? It is also the fuzzy strip that sticks together with a satisfying rip sound, but it is NOT your hood!
quests.question: Velcro
quests.hint: Hint: It is often used instead of shoelaces.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Velcro is a fuzzy fastener that sticks together with a satisfying rip!
quests.funFact: Many children's shoes use Velcro because it's easier than tying laces.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the piece we do up carefully, one at a time, from bottom to top? It is also the small, round piece we push through a little hole to close a shirt, but it is NOT your waistband!
quests.question: Button
quests.hint: Hint: You do these up one at a time.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Button is a small piece that pushes through a hole to close your clothes!
quests.funFact: Doing up your own buttons is a great skill for getting dressed alone.

quests.instruction: We wear this on the very coldest days, warmer than regular gloves, but it is not your bow tie. What is it?
quests.question: Mittens
quests.hint: Only your thumb gets its own little space.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Mittens keep your fingers snuggled together, which makes them extra warm!
quests.funFact: Only your thumb gets its own separate space in a mitten.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the pouch we slip our hand into to keep our fingers warm? It is also the small pouch sewn into pants or a jacket for holding tiny things, but it is NOT your waistband!
quests.question: Pocket
quests.hint: Hint: You slip your hand inside to warm your fingers.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Pocket is a small pouch sewn in for holding coins, toys, or notes!
quests.funFact: You can warm your hands by slipping them into a cozy pocket.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that ties with a soft belt around our waist, not your apron. What is it?
quests.question: Bathrobe
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It is thick, fluffy, and cozy.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Bathrobe is thick and fluffy, worn to stay warm right after a bath!
quests.funFact: Hotels often leave a cozy bathrobe for guests to relax in.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this under a skirt or dress to keep our legs warm, not your jeans. What is it?
quests.question: Tights
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Dancers often wear these to ballet class.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Tights cover your legs and feet in one thin, stretchy piece for warmth!
quests.funFact: Tights are thinner and smoother than stretchy leggings.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the fastener with a little metal tab we pull up and down? It is also the row of tiny teeth we zip up in one smooth pull, but it is NOT your waistband!
quests.question: Zipper
quests.hint: Hint: It closes clothes faster than buttons do.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Zipper has tiny teeth that lock together in one smooth pull to close clothes!
quests.funFact: A zipper can get stuck if a bit of fabric gets caught in its teeth.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the strings we practice tying into a neat bow as we learn to dress ourselves? It is also the long strings we thread through little holes and tie in a bow, but it is NOT your velcro!
quests.question: Shoelaces
quests.hint: Hint: They keep your shoes snug on your feet.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Shoelaces are the strings that tie into a bow to keep your shoes snug!
quests.funFact: Shoelaces can come undone while running, so a double knot helps.

quests.instruction: What do we call the edge of a shirt that a button often closes at the top? It is not your zipper!
quests.question: Collar
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is a small part, not a whole piece of clothing!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Collar is the folded edge of a shirt that circles your neck!
quests.funFact: A collar is the folded part of a shirt that circles your neck!

quests.instruction: What is the name for the part of a jacket sleeve that stops right at our hand? It is also the end of a sleeve that circles snugly around our wrist, but it is NOT your zipper!
quests.question: Cuff
quests.hint: Hint: You push this up before washing your hands.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Cuff is the end of a sleeve that circles snugly around your wrist!
quests.funFact: Some fancy shirt cuffs button closed, while others stay open.

quests.instruction: We wear this on the coldest days, when even our neck needs covering. It is NOT your hoodie. What is it?
quests.question: Turtleneck
quests.hint: Here's a clue: Its collar reaches all the way up your neck!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Turtleneck has a tall collar that covers your neck for extra warmth!
quests.funFact: A turtleneck has a tall collar that covers your whole neck!

quests.instruction: We wear this over our shoulders instead of a belt, to hold pants up. It is also worn instead of a belt, when we want our hands free of adjusting, but it is NOT your mittens. What is it?
quests.question: Suspenders
quests.hint: Think about this: They clip onto the front and back of your pants.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Suspenders clip over your shoulders to hold your pants up without a belt!
quests.funFact: Suspenders clip onto your pants at both the front and the back.

quests.instruction: We wear this on a warm day when we do not need long sleeves. It is NOT your pocket. What is it?
quests.question: T-Shirt
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has short sleeves!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: T-shirts are named for their shape, which looks like the letter T!

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this instead of regular pants, with pockets on the chest too, not your pajamas. What is it?
quests.question: Overalls
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Farmers often wear these while working.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Overalls have shoulder straps and a front panel, so they never need a belt!
quests.funFact: Overalls have a big front pocket, perfect for carrying small tools.

quests.instruction: What do we call the part of a hoodie that gives the hoodie its very name? It is not your shoelaces!
quests.question: Hood
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You will not find this sold on its own in a shop!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Hood is the part that pulls up over your head to keep rain off!
quests.funFact: A hood is a soft, floppy part that pulls up to keep rain off your head!

quests.instruction: We wear this that we can leave open or button all the way up. It is NOT your sweatshirt. What is it?
quests.question: Cardigan
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It opens all the way down the front!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Cardigan opens down the front with buttons, making it easy to put on!
quests.funFact: A cardigan opens all the way down the front, so it's easy to put on!

quests.instruction: We wear this before we get on a boat or go swimming in deep water. It is also worn on a canoe or sailboat, to stay safe near deep water, but it is NOT your cap. What is it?
quests.question: Life Jacket
quests.hint: Think about this: It buckles around your chest.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Life Jacket helps you float safely, worn for water safety near deep water!
quests.funFact: Wearing a life jacket on a boat keeps everyone safer near deep water.

quests.instruction: We wear this that covers our whole body, from our neck to our ankles, in one piece. It is also worn instead of just a coat, for a whole day of playing in deep snow, but it is NOT your poncho. What is it?
quests.question: Snowsuit
quests.hint: Think about this: It is thick and puffy.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Snowsuit covers your whole body in one warm piece for playing in deep snow!
quests.funFact: Snowsuits keep you warm even while you build snowmen for hours.

quests.instruction: We wear this that ties around our neck and flows out behind us. It is also worn instead of a jacket, for a bold, heroic look, but it is NOT your sunglasses. What is it?
quests.question: Cape
quests.hint: Think about this: Superheroes often wear these.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Cape ties at your neck and flows behind you for a bold, heroic look!
quests.funFact: Superheroes in stories almost always wear a bold, flowing cape.

quests.instruction: We wear this that is thick, soft, and warm, but has no hood at all. It is also worn after playing sports, to stay warm while we cool down, but it is NOT your vest. What is it?
quests.question: Sweatshirt
quests.hint: Think about this: It pulls over your head.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Sweatshirt is thick and warm like a hoodie, but has no hood at all!
quests.funFact: Sweatshirts were first made for athletes to wear before and after playing.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of jeans when we want something soft and flexible, but it is not your pants. What is it?
quests.question: Leggings
quests.hint: They are thinner and more flexible than jeans.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Leggings are soft and stretchy, moving easily with your legs when you play!
quests.funFact: Leggings can be worn alone or underneath a skirt or dress.

quests.instruction: We wear this on our head to stay safe while riding a bike. It is also worn before we skateboard, ski, or ride a scooter, but it is NOT your earmuffs. What is it?
quests.question: Helmet
quests.hint: Think about this: It is hard on the outside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Helmet has a hard shell that protects your head during sports and biking!
quests.funFact: Helmets buckle snugly under your chin so they stay in place.
